info.name: IKEA After Purchase Ordering Availability Products API

params.name: productIdSuffix
params.description:
Product ID Suffix (last 3 digits of Product ID)
Value can be:
  *  zero (`0`) or
  * Product ID Suffix (`406`)

params.name: productId
params.description:
Product identifier
Value can be:
  *  zero (`0`),
  * product identifier (`00263850`) or
  * product identifier with `s` prefix (`s59047406`)

info.name: IKEA Get a Limited Set of Filtered Products

items.docs: Returns a window of products that matches the filtered criteria.

info.name: IKEA Get a Paginated Set of Filtered Products

params.name: start
params.description: The zero-based index of the first item to include in the response. For example, `start=0` begins from the very first item. If `start` is provided but not `end`, then default for `end=24`.

params.name: end
params.description: The zero-based index of the last item to include **exclusive**. For example, `start=0&end=2` returns items at index 0 and 1. (2 items) If `end` is provided but not `end`, then default for `start=24`.

items.docs: Returns a window of paginated products that matches the filtered criteria.
